gU0 - svedAnantaraM vamanasyoktatvAdvamanamAha - tatrAdau vamanakAlamAha - Saraditi | SaratkAle vasante prAvRuTkAle eShu triShveva ca dehinAM manuShyANAM vamanaM recanaM ca kArayet | yaH kuSalo BiShak pravINavaidyaH sa~jcayaM j~jAtvA vamanonmuKaM doShaM j~jAtvA, anyathA svasthaviShaye doShadarSanAt | tathAcoktaM granthAntare - 'BiShajaH SodhanaM prAhurvarjyaH svasthena sarvadA | pannagasya vadhovaMkShNe doShasya samudIraNam’ iti | nanu SaratkAle pittasyA~api vamanaM yuktaM vasante kaPasyA~api vamanaM recanaM yuktam | dvayoH prAvRuTkAle vA hetutvAtkathaM vamanaM recanaM dIyate tatra vAtAdhikyaM kathaM syAt ? ucyate - varShAkAle niShedho, na prAvRuTkAle | tathAcoktam agniveSena - ‘ativiShTenAtiGarme prAvRuDityaBidhIyate | tatraiva SodhanaM pathyaM varShAsu kadAcana’ iti | Sodhanena sarvadoShanASo BavatItyeke | tathAcoktaM tIsaTe - 'prAvRuTGanAtyayavasantadineShu yasmAt prAdurBavanti pavanAdirujastataSca | vAtAdidoShavigamAcca SarIraSuddhiH' iti | ambudAgamaSaranmadhuvAsareShu agniveSena triShveva ca SodhanaM nAnyeShu | tathAcoktaM - 'triShu tvanuSItatvAtpreShThaM SeSheShu Sodhanam | hitaM Bavati yasmAcca tatra hetuM nibodha me’ iti || 1 ||

vya_text: gU0 - eteShvapi ajIrNavyathitA vAmyAH, kaPavyAptASca vAmyAH | madhUko guDapuShpaH tatkvAthapAnataH | kRuSabAlavRuddhAnAmapi punaruktiviSeShaniShedhArthaH | vamanAdau yadvihitaM tadAha - ‘naraH Svo vamanaM pAtA Bu~jjIta kaPavardhanam | sujaraM dravaBUyiShThaM laGu SItaM virecanam ||’ iti | yavAgUm AkaNThaM pItvA asAtmyaiH arucyaiH SleShmavardhakai: BojyairvA doShAnutkleSya dehinaH puruShasya snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate | snigdhAya kRutaGRutapAnAya sveditAya | nanu snehapAnAtsvedAtkadA vamanaM deyam ? tadAha granthAntarAt - atra nAsti | tathAca BeDaH ‘ekAhaM parataH snehAt sthitvA pracCardanaM pibet | BuktvA grAmyodakairmAMsairanUpaiSca susaMskRutaiH | trirAtrAt paratastadvat svedAtprakledanaM pibet iti || 9-11 ||

dI0 - ete pUrvoktAstimiryAdayaH te yadA ajIrNavyathitA upaviShapIDitAH kaPavyAptA vA Bavanti tadA vAmyA ityaBiprAyaH | kaPavyAptA iti niyatam | tathAhi - ‘kaPaje vamanaM SastaM recanaM pittaje gade | bastirvAtagate kAye Amaye tvAmapAcana’miti | kena vAmyAstamAha - madhukvAthasya pAnata iti | madhukvAtho madhuyaShTIkvAthaH | yadvA madhu kShaudraM | kvAthaM kvathitaM jalaM | anyadvihitadravyaSRutaM vA prakaraNatvAt | kaShAyaScAtra sarvaH koShNaH kArya iti carakavacanAt | uShNavirodhitvena madhUShNaM niShiddhamiti vivakShAyAM na cAtra madhUShNaM viruddhaM | yaduktaM - ‘pracCardane nirUhe ca madhUShNaM na nivArayet | alaGvapAkamASveva tayostasmAnnivartate’ iti | ata eva yAtyadhodoShamAdAya pacyamAnaM virecanaM | guNotkarShaNAtdUrdhvamapakvaM vamanaM punariti | yadA~ajIrNAdipIDitatimirAdayo~api sukumArAdiShu Bavanti tadA vakShyamANaprayogenaiva vAmyA ityata Aha - vamanasAdhyavikArapIDitAH sukumArAdayo~api yavAgvAdInAmanyatamenAkaNThaM pAyayitvA vAmayedityarthaH | yavAgvapyanena kaPakaratvAt kaPotkleSanArthamityaBiprAyaH | yaduktaM ‘pAMSudhAnye yathA vRuShTiH kledayatyatikardamam | tathA SleShmaNi saMvRuddhe yavAgU SleShmavardhanI’ti | ityaBiprAyaviShayaM vakShyamANenaiva caritArthatvAt | kShIratakradadhi yathAdoShApekShayA vyastaM deyaM | pUrvamuktaM vakShyamANenaiva caritArthatvAttAnAha - ‘asAtmyaiH SleShmalairBojyairdoShAnukteSca dehinaH | snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate | snigdhasvinnAyeti snehapAnapUrvakAya KedapUrvakAya puruShAyetyarthaH | na tu snehasvedAyeti, yataH snehapAnAdekAhamuparatamaparAdinA etatsvinnamiti prasiddhiH | BAlukinA snehapAnAt tryahena vamanaM darSitaM | tadyathA ‘snigdhasvinnaSarIrasya dadyAtpracCardanaM tryahAt | daSarAtre gate vAnte BUyo dadyAdvirecana’miti || 9-11 ||

dI0 - atha durvAnte lakShaNamAha – duSCardite durvAnte puruShe ki~jcidvAnte ityaBiprAyaH | praseko muKasya kaPastrAva ityarthaH | hRudgraho hRudayAviSuddhiH | hRudroga ityapare | koThaH kShudraroge paThitaH sa yathA ‘varaTIdaShTasaMkASaH kaNDUmAn lohitAmrakaPapittAn | kShaNikotpAdavinASaH koTha iti nigadyate tajj~jai’riti | duSCarditA ca vAntividhAraNAdeva proktA | tasmAdapi koThAdayaH saMBavanti | tathAhi - ‘visarpakoThakuShThAkShikaNDUpANDvAmayajvarAH | sakAsaSvAsahRullAsavya~ggaSca Svayathurvame’riti | vameriti vAntividhAraNAdityarthaH | asyAnte taccikitsArthaM sArdhaM SlokaM kecitpaThanti | tadyathA - ‘gaNDUShadhUmAnAhArAn rUkShaM BuktvA tadudvamaH | vyAyAmaM Srutirasrasya SastaM cAtra virecanaM | sakShAralavaNaM tailamaBya~ggArthe ca Sasyata’ iti prakShepakamanyamAnairasmABirapi na liKitaM, yato bahupustakeShu na dRuSyate || 22 ||

pada:

vya_text: gU0 - vamanAtivyAptau tadrogaSAntyarthaM cikitsitamAha - vamanasyAtiyogaScettadA recanaM kuryAt | vamanAtiyoge jihvApratIkAramAha - vamane antaHpraviShTAyAM jihvAyAM snigdhAmlalavaNairGRutakShIrarasaiH kavalagraho hitaH | tasyAgrato~aneke narAH amlanimbukAdIni PalAni KAdeyu: sugamam | vyAvRutte~akShNi cikitsitamAha - vyAvRuttekShNi prasArite~akShNi GRutAByakte SanaiH pIDayet | hanumokShe kriyAmAha - stamBAddhanumokShakaraNe svedaH smRutaH | SleShmavAtaharaM nasyam | atha raktacCardipratIkAramAha - raktapittavidhAnena raktapittacitkitsitena raktacCardimupAcaret cikitset | aticCardijanitatRuShNAcikitsitamAha - dhAtrI AmalakI, rasA~jjanaM dArvIkvAthodBUtam, uSIraM prasiddhaM lAjA dhAnyajAH, candanaM SItaM, vAri netravAlakam | eBirmanthaM kRutvA pAyayet | kiMBUtaM manthaM ? saGRutaM kShaudraSarkaraM, GRutaM gavyaM, kShaudraM madhu, SarkarA sitA etaiH sahitam | anena manthena yA tRuShNAstAH SAmyanti | tathA CardisamudBavAH pIDAH SAmyanti || 24-29 ||

dI0 - atha vamanAtiSayotpannAnAM rogANAM cikitsAmAha - snigdhAmlalavaNairhRudyairGRutamanatiSIlanena praBavA tRuShNAdirogA eBirvihiprayogaiH SAmyantItyaBiprAyaH | kathaM yathetyAha - yadA vamanAtiyogo Bavati tadA mRuduvirecanaM dadyAt | mRuduvirecanaM mastukShIrAdinA | aparamapi dvividhaprakAraniHsarpitajihvAyA yogacatuShTayamuktaM tadvyAKyAnamAha - vamanAntaHpraviShTAyAmityAdi | antaHpraviShTAyAmiti saMkucitAyAm, atra kavalagrahAH snigdhAdyaiH kalpitAH hitAH pathyA ityarthaH | snigdhaM tailAdi, amlo amlikA mAtulu~ggAdiH, lavaNaH saindhavAdiH | eteShAM madhye hRudyairmanohlAdakarairityarthaH | GRutakShIrasamairiti | GRutakShIramilitairityarthaH | nanu snehagrahaNenaiva GRutagrahaNaprAptireva tatkathaM punarGRutagrahaNam ? ucyate, snigdhaSabdetyukte punarGRutopAdAnaM snehakriyAtiSayadyotanArtham | aparamapyupAyamAha - PalAnItyAdi | amlAnIti jambIranimbukapraBRutIni tasyAgrata iti | tasya jihvArtasya puruShasyetyarthaH | purato~agrataH sthitveti SeShaH | anyanarA iti anyapuruShAH | anena jihvA calitA BavatItyaBiprAyaH | etaccAntaHpraviShTAyAM bahirniHsRutAyAM ca jihvAyAM boddhavyam | atha ni:sRutAyAH pRuthagyogadvayamAha - niHsRutAmityAdi | niHsRutAM bahirnirgatAM jihvAmiti SeShaH | tiladrAkShAkalkamatra sAmyena kevalamAhuH | aparamapi vyAvRutte~akShNi yogamAha - GRutAByakta iti | vyAvRudityapi pAThAntaraM | vyAvRuditi jihvA pUrvakalkAdinA calitetyarthaH | yadi calitA jAtA drAkShAkShIraGRutAByakte sati jihvAM SanaiH SanaiH kRutvA pIDayet | antarnayediti BAvaH | hanumokShArthamapyAha hanumokShe smRutaH sveda ityAdi | Kedo~atra caturNAM madhye vihitasveda eva kAryaH | nasyamapi tadvihitam | tacca SleShmavAtaGnadravyarahitamityarthaH | tena SleShmavAtaGnaM yannasyaM taddeyaM; apare yogamenaM SleShmavAtaGnaM BavatIti vyAKyAnayanti | yataH kaPavAtanirharaNatvena hanumokShaH syAt tanmUlatvAt | anye SleShmavAtaGnaM BavatIti vyAKyAnayanti | yataH kaPavAtanirharaNatvena hanumokShaH syAt, tanmUlatvAta#094D; anye SleShmavAtahRudityanenAparamapyupAyaM kathayanti | tadvicArya yojyAnIti | raktacCardyAmapi yogamAha - raktapittavidhAnenetyAdi | raktapittavidhAnaM raktapittacikitsAyAmanyatamena j~jAtavyaM | anyopadravANAM cikitsitamAha - dhAtrIrasA~jjanoSIretyAdi | dhAtrI AmalakIPalaM, rasA~jjanaM dArvIkvAthasamudBavam, uSIraM mRuNAlaM, lAjA BRuShTadhAnyapraBavAH | candanaM raktaM | vAriBiriti | eteShAM vAri toyaM grAhyaM | SRutatvAt kalkatvAcca || 24-29 ||

dI0 - hRucCuddhiH hRudayalaGutArUpA, kaNThaSuddhiH kaNThe pATavaM kaNThasthaSleShmApagamAt | SiraHSuddhiH SirolaGutvaM tatsthapIDAdivinASAt | dIptAgnitvamiti | nanu vAntasya sahasA mando~agnirBavati | uktaMca - ‘saMSodhanAsravisrAvasnehayojanala~gGanaiH | yAtyagnirmandatAM tasmAt kramaM peyAdikaM Bajet’ iti | tatkathamatra dIptAgnitvam ? iti | ucyate - atra SodhanenAgnirupaGAto Bavati nAgnerhAniH, tasyopaGAtasya peyAdipathyadAnena punardIptatvAt dIptatvam | uktaMca dRuDhabalena -‘peyAM vilepImakRutaM kRuta~jca yUShaM rasaM trInuBayaM tathaikam | krameNa seveta naro~annakAlaM pradhAnamadhyAvaraSuddhiSuddha:’ iti | tathA~aNuragnistRuNagomayAdyaiH saMdhukShamANo Bavati krameNa | mahAn sthiraH sarvasamaM tathaiva Suddhasya peyAdiBirantarAgniriti | tasmAddIptAgnitvaM yuktaM, tathA lAGavaM SarIsya, ata eva kaPapittavinASaSca iti | ityanena SarIrapATavamapyuktam | athavA vAntisamaye taddina evAgnihAnirdurvAnte ca | samyagvAnte aparadine ca dIpto~agnirityadoShaH | ata eva vakShyamANaSloke ‘ajIrNArditaM varjayet’ sudhIriti grahaNAt || 30 ||
